$comment: The LIFE-1 game-launch decision table (contracts.md#life-1--game-coordination, 'Decision table at game launch'). Normative and supersedes any prose elsewhere. Rows are evaluated in order; this fixture preserves that order so B1's implementation and its tests can walk it top-to-bottom and stop at the first match, exactly as the contract specifies.

rows.condition: stale-generation and its last validated policy explicitly says lifecycle.game: "ignore"
rows.note: Launch immediately after the universal active-record commit. The stale process is outside game coordination by its retained policy.

rows.condition: stale-generation with stop/notify policy, or with no trustworthy retained policy
rows.note: Treat as an unverified stop. Never infer absence from a missing/invalid pak, disabled desired state, or missing/recycled pgid.

rows.condition: no stale generation, and no pak, manifest invalid, service disabled, or lifecycle.game: "ignore"
service enabled but process group proven absent by ownership identity

rows.note: Run the SVC-1 stop sequence; verify absence; launch.
Run the waiting/ready/error exchange bounded by wait_ms + ack_ms.

rows.condition: live service, mode notify, not subscribed (starting, crashed IPC, reconnecting, or never subscribed)
any exchange failure: error, timeout, malformed message or frame, dropped connection
rows.note: Falls back exactly like an unsubscribed live service.

rows.condition: stop cannot be verified in any row above
rows.note: Per SVC-1 'when a stop cannot be verified': surface and require explicit user override.

actions_glossary.launch-immediately: Launch immediately after the universal active-record commit. Zero service-induced wait.
actions_glossary.surface-and-require-override: Do not launch silently. Surface the stuck/possible-writer service and require an explicit user override to continue.
actions_glossary.stop-verify-launch: Run the SVC-1 stop sequence, verify absence, then launch. Bounded by stop_grace_ms + 2000ms.
actions_glossary.run-exchange: Send game.start, run the waiting/ready/error exchange bounded by wait_ms + ack_ms, then launch.

key_distinction: absent means no writer exists; unsubscribed means a writer may exist and the cooperative channel is gone. Only the first is a free pass.
